# upsolve with rainboy
import sys
from collections import deque

class CF1187G:
    INF = 0x3f3f3f3f
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.sys_in = sys.stdin
        self.sys_out = sys.stdout
        self.readline = sys.stdin.readline
    
    def init(self):
        self.aa_ = [[] for _ in range(self.n_)]
        self.pi = [self.INF] * self.n_
        self.dd = [0] * self.n_
        self.bb = [0] * self.n_
        self.q = [0] * self.nq
        self.iq = [False] * self.n_
        self.uu = [0] * self.m_
        self.vv = [0] * self.m_
        self.uv = [0] * self.m_
        self.cost = [0] * self.m_
        self.cc = [0] * (self.m_ * 2)
        self.m_ = 0

    def read_ints(self):
        return list(map(int, self.readline().strip().split()))
    
    def link(self, u, v, cap, cos):
        h = self.m_
        self.m_ += 1
        self.uu[h] = u
        self.vv[h] = v
        self.uv[h] = u ^ v
        self.cost[h] = cos
        self.cc[h*2] = cap
        self.aa_[u].append(h * 2)
        self.aa_[v].append(h * 2 + 1)
    
    def enqueue(self, v):
        if self.iq[v]:
            return
        if self.head + self.cnt == self.nq:
            if self.cnt * 2 <= self.nq:
                self.q[:self.cnt] = self.q[self.head:self.head+self.cnt]
            else:
                self.q = self.q[self.head:self.head+self.cnt] + [0] * (self.nq - self.cnt)
                self.nq *= 2
            self.head = 0
        self.q[self.head + self.cnt] = v
        self.cnt += 1
        self.iq[v] = True
    
    def dequeue(self):
        u = self.q[self.head]
        self.head += 1
        self.cnt -= 1
        self.iq[u] = False
        return u
    
    def spfa(self, s, t):
        for i in range(self.n_):
            self.pi[i] = self.INF
        self.pi[s] = 0
        self.head = 0
        self.cnt = 0
        self.enqueue(s)
        while self.cnt > 0:
            u = self.dequeue()
            d = self.dd[u] + 1
            for h_ in self.aa_[u]:
                if self.cc[h_] > 0:
                    h = h_ >> 1
                    p = self.pi[u] + (self.cost[h] if (h_ & 1) == 0 else -self.cost[h])
                    v = u ^ self.uv[h]
                    if self.pi[v] > p or (self.pi[v] == p and self.dd[v] > d):
                        self.pi[v] = p
                        self.dd[v] = d
                        self.bb[v] = h_
                        self.enqueue(v)
        return self.pi[t] != self.INF

    def push(self, s, t):
        c = self.INF
        u = t
        while u != s:
            h_ = self.bb[u]
            h = h_ >> 1
            c = min(c, self.cc[h_])
            u ^= self.uv[h]
        u = t
        while u != s:
            h_ = self.bb[u]
            h = h_ >> 1
            self.cc[h_] -= c
            self.cc[h_ ^ 1] += c
            u ^= self.uv[h]
    
    def push1(self, s, t):
        u = t
        while u != s:
            h_ = self.bb[u]
            h = h_ >> 1
            self.cc[h_] -= 1
            self.cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
            u ^= self.uv[h]
    
    def edmonds_karp(self, s, t):
        while self.spfa(s, t):
            self.push1(s, t)
        c = 0
        for h in range(self.m_):
            c += self.cost[h] * self.cc[h * 2 + 1]
        return c
    
    def main(self):
        input_vals = self.read_ints()
        self.n, self.m, self.k, self.c, self.d = input_vals
        self.ii = [x - 1 for x in self.read_ints()]
        self.aa = [[] for _ in range(self.n)]
        for _ in range(self.m):
            u, v = self.read_ints()
            u -= 1
            v -= 1
            self.aa[u].append(v)
            self.aa[v].append(u)
        
        self.t = self.n + self.k + 1
        self.n_ = self.n * self.t + 1
        self.m_ = self.k + (self.m * 2 * self.k + self.n) * (self.t - 1)
        self.init()
        
        for i in range(self.n):
            adj = self.aa[i]
            for s in range(self.t - 1):
                u = i * self.t + s
                for j in adj:
                    v = j * self.t + s + 1
                    for x in range(1, self.k + 1):
                        self.link(u, v, 1, self.c + (2 * x - 1) * self.d)
        
        for i in range(self.n):
            for s in range(self.t - 1):
                u = i * self.t + s
                v = u + 1
                self.link(u, v, self.k, 0 if i == 0 else self.c)
        
        for h in range(self.k):
            self.link(self.n_ - 1, self.ii[h] * self.t + 0, 1, 0)
        
        result = self.edmonds_karp(self.n_ - 1, 0 * self.t + self.t - 1)
        self.sys_out.write(str(result) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solver = CF1187G()
    solver.main()
